QuestInfo.name: A Hole in The Nautilus
QuestInfo.0: Code red! There's a hole in the ship and The Nautilus is in danger!  The Nautilus' crew, Bonnie, is trying everything to stop the hole all by herself... We can't let The Nautilus sink like this! I must go and help!
QuestInfo.1: The hole on the ship must be stopped with a Solid Horn. You should go find #b30 Solid Horns#k before Bonnie loses all her strength.  \n\n#i4000073##t4000073#  #b#c4000073#/30#k
QuestInfo.2: Whew, I can't believe we saved The Nautilus from sinking into the ocean. Bonnie and I saved The Nautilus!

0.0: My fingers are losing their grip now... I can't do this much longer... if I let my hand go, the ship will sink... please help...somebody...

yes.0: You want to help? Then hurry up and get me #b30 Solid Horns#k. There is a hole in the ship, and it must be blocked. If we don't do anything about it, the Nautilus may sink. I'll clog the hole with my finger for now, so hurry up!

no.0: Ahhh... The Nautilus might sink, though...

1.0: Did you bring the Solid Horns? Yes! Thank goodness. Please give me those right now. I better plug this hole with the horn.

yes.0: That should temporarily take care of it. We better fix this ship soon.

item.0: You need to bring me 30 Solid Horns. I have to block the hole in the ship.
